d:
The Lakers defeated the Clippers, 103-87 tonight in LA. Quentin Grimes finished with a team-high 23 points along with 5 assists and 4 steals for the Lakers, while Collin Sexton tallied 21 points, 4 rebounds and 4 three pointers in the game. Keaton Wagler recorded 21 points, 4 rebounds and 3 three pointers. The Lakers improve their record to 4-1 with the win, while the Clippers fall to 1-3 for the season.
